segments.source: This document describes the schedule and other details of the 2023 election for the Python steering council, as specified in :pep:`13`.
segments.translation: 이 문서는 :pep:`13`\ 에 명시된 Python 운영위원회의 2023년 선거 일정과 기타 세부 사항을 설명합니다.

segments.source: This is the steering council election for the 2024 term (i.e. Python 3.13).
segments.translation: 이는 2024년 임기(즉, Python 3.13)를 위한 운영위원회 선거입니다.

segments.source: The steering council appointed the `Python Software Foundation <https://www.python.org/psf-landing/>`__ Director of Infrastructure, Ee Durbin, to administer the election.
segments.translation: 운영위원회는 `Python Software Foundation <https://www.python.org/psf-landing/>`__\ 의 인프라 책임자인 Ee Durbin을 선거 관리자로 임명했습니다.

segments.source: There was a two-week nomination period, followed by a two-week vote.
segments.translation: 2주간의 후보 추천 기간에 이어 2주간의 투표가 진행되었습니다.

segments.source: The nomination period was: November 9, 2023 through `November 22, 2023 AoE <https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=Python+Steering+Council+nominations+close&iso=20231123T00&p1=3399>`_ [#note-aoe]_.

The voting period was: November 27, 2023 through `December 11, 2023 AoE <https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=Python+Steering+Council+voting+closes&iso=20231212T00&p1=3399>`_ [#note-aoe]_.
Candidates must be nominated by a core team member.
segments.translation: 후보자는 핵심 팀 구성원의 추천을 받아야 합니다.

segments.source: If the candidate is a core team member, they may nominate themselves.
segments.translation: 후보자가 핵심 팀 구성원인 경우에는 스스로를 추천할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Nominees (in alphabetical order by first name):
All active Python core team members are eligible to vote.
segments.translation: 활동 중인 모든 Python 핵심 팀 구성원은 투표할 자격이 있습니다.

segments.source: Active status is determined as :pep:`described in PEP 13 <13#membership>` and implemented via the software at `python/voters <https://github.com/python/voters>`_ [#note-voters]_.
segments.translation: 활동 상태는 :pep:`described in PEP 13 <13#membership>`\ 에 설명된 대로 결정되며, `python/voters <https://github.com/python/voters>`_ [#note-voters]_\ 의 소프트웨어를 통해 구현됩니다.

segments.source: Ballots were be distributed based on the the `Python Voter Roll <https://github.com/python/voters/blob/master/voter-files/>`_ [#note-voters]_ for this election.
segments.translation: 이번 선거의 투표용지는 `Python Voter Roll <https://github.com/python/voters/blob/master/voter-files/>`_ [#note-voters]_\ 을 기반으로 배포되었습니다.

segments.source: While this file is not public as it contains private email addresses, the `Complete Voter Roll`_ is available with a list of all eligible voters by name.
segments.translation: 이 파일에는 개인 이메일 주소가 포함되어 있어 공개되지 않지만, 이름별로 모든 투표 자격 유권자 목록을 제공하는 `Complete Voter Roll`_\ 을 이용할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: The election was be conducted using the `Helios Voting Service <https://heliosvoting.org>`__.
segments.translation: 선거는 `Helios Voting Service <https://heliosvoting.org>`__\ 를 사용하여 진행되었습니다.

segments.source: Description: ``Election for the Python steering council, as specified in PEP 13.
segments.translation: 설명: ``Election for the Python steering council, as specified in PEP 13.

segments.source: This is steering council election for the 2024 term.``
segments.translation: This is steering council election for the 2024 term.``

segments.source: This will create an election in which:
Voting is not open to the public, only those on the `Voter Roll`_ may participate.
segments.translation: 투표는 일반 대중에게 공개되지 않으며, `Voter Roll`_\ 에 등재된 사람만 참여할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Ballots will be emailed when voting starts.
Candidates are presented in random order, to help avoid bias.
segments.translation: 편향을 방지하기 위해 후보자가 무작위 순서로 제시됩니다.

segments.source: Voter identities and ballots are protected against cryptographic advances.
segments.translation: 유권자의 신원과 투표용지는 암호 기술의 발전으로부터 보호됩니다.

segments.source: Question: ``Select candidates for the Python Steering Council``
segments.translation: 질문: ``Select candidates for the Python Steering Council``

segments.source: Due to a mismatch between announced timeline and the initial election implementation an extended election is held to provide the additional day for voters who were disenfranchised by the initial election.
segments.translation: 공지된 일정과 최초 선거 구현이 일치하지 않아, 최초 선거로 인해 투표권을 행사하지 못한 유권자에게 하루를 추가로 제공하기 위해 확장 선거를 실시합니다.

segments.source: Results from the initial election were combined with the results from the extended election.
segments.translation: 최초 선거의 결과는 확장 선거의 결과와 통합되었습니다.

segments.source: Only voters who **DID NOT** cast ballots in the initial election were able to vote.
segments.translation: 최초 선거에서 투표하지 **않은** 유권자만 투표할 수 있었습니다.

segments.source: The election was be conducted using the `Helios Voting Service <https://heliosvoting.org>`__.
segments.translation: 선거는 `Helios Voting Service <https://heliosvoting.org>`__\ 를 사용하여 실시되었습니다.

segments.source: Name: ``2024 Python Steering Council Election Extension``
segments.translation: 이름: ``2024 Python Steering Council Election Extension``

segments.source: Description: ``Election for the Python steering council, as specified in PEP 13.
segments.translation: 설명: ``PEP 13에 명시된 Python 운영 위원회 선거입니다.

segments.source: This is steering council election for the 2024 term.``
This will create an election in which:
Voting is not open to the public, only those on the `Voter Roll`_ may participate.
segments.translation: 투표는 일반에 공개되지 않으며, `Voter Roll`_\ 에 등재된 사람만 참여할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Ballots will be emailed when voting starts.
Candidates are presented in random order, to help avoid bias.
segments.translation: 편향을 방지하기 위해 후보자는 무작위 순서로 표시됩니다.

segments.source: Voter identities and ballots are protected against cryptographic advances.
segments.translation: 유권자의 신원과 투표용지는 암호 기술의 발전으로부터 보호됩니다.

segments.source: Question: ``Select candidates for the Python Steering Council``
No conflict of interest as defined in :pep:`13` were observed.
segments.translation: 이해 충돌은 :pep:`13`\ 에서 정의된 바와 같이 관찰되지 않았습니다.

segments.source: The full vote counts are as follows:
12 of 31 eligible voters disenfranchised in the initial election cast ballots.
segments.translation: 초기 선거에서 투표권을 박탈당한 선거권이 있는 유권자 31명 중 12명이 투표했습니다.
투표 자격이 있는 유권자 87명 중 68명이 투표했습니다.
